meaning: Power failure: LG says PF means the power supply to the washer was interrupted during a cycle, for example by a power outage.
causes: A power outage or interruption while a cycle was running, the cause LG gives
Power cut at the outlet or circuit breaker mid-cycle
diySteps: Unplug the washer, or switch off the circuit breaker that supplies it
While the washer has no power, press and hold the START/PAUSE button for 5 seconds
Restore power and try to run a cycle
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If PF keeps appearing after this reset, LG says the washer will require a repair service.
sourceTitle: LG Front Load Washer – Error Code List (LG USA Support)
